edges.reason: msg.sender is the recipient of the ETH transfer in withdraw, so an attacker-controlled contract can reenter during the call
withdraw performs an external ETH transfer to msg.sender instead of a pull pattern, enabling reentrancy
mint calls _safeMint which executes the external onERC721Received callback on a contract recipient
mint5 loops over _safeMint, repeatedly invoking the external receiver callback
reserveTokens mints via _safeMint, triggering the external onERC721Received callback
msg.sender is the recipient address of _safeMint, so the caller controls the external callback target
flipSaleState mutates the saleIsActive state variable and is guarded by onlyOwner
address(this).balance is read into the local balance variable in withdraw
the maxSupply parameter overwrites the MAX_SUPPLY state variable under onlyOwner protection
setMaxTokenSupply writes MAX_SUPPLY and is restricted to the contract owner
totalSupply() is cached in the local supply variable in reserveTokens
the cached supply value is used as the token id for _safeMint
the reserveTokens loop counter drives repeated _safeMint invocations
the mint5 loop counter drives five repeated _safeMint invocations
mint requires the saleIsActive state variable to be true before minting
mint5 requires the saleIsActive state variable to be true before minting
calcStartingIndex derives and writes the startingIndex state variable
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive the pseudo-random index
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock and is owner-only
setBaseURI overwrites the _baseURIExtended state variable and is owner-only
the baseURI_ parameter is stored into the _baseURIExtended state variable
_baseURI returns the _baseURIExtended state variable
tokenURI calls the internal _baseURI accessor
the result of _baseURI() is assigned to the local base variable in tokenURI
the tokenId parameter indexes the _tokenURIs mapping in tokenURI
the per-token URI from _tokenURIs is read into the local _tokenURI variable
mint mints the new token directly to the untrusted msg.sender
mint5 mints all five tokens directly to the untrusted msg.sender
mint5 performs SafeMath add and mul arithmetic over supply and price where unchecked library blocks are involved
calcStartingIndex performs SafeMath sub between block.number and startingIndexBlock

normalization_plan.reason: the num parameter exists only to bound the reserveTokens minting loop and should be merged into that function node
the maxSupply parameter is a direct input that is written into MAX_SUPPLY inside setMaxTokenSupply
the baseURI_ parameter is only used to overwrite _baseURIExtended inside setBaseURI
the tokenId parameter is only used for existence checks and mapping lookups inside tokenURI
the balance local is a transient cache of address(this).balance used solely by the withdraw function
the supply local is derived from totalSupply() and consumed only within reserveTokens minting
the loop counter i is internal bookkeeping for the reserveTokens minting loop
the loop counter i is internal bookkeeping for the mint5 minting loop
the base local holds the _baseURI() return value used only inside tokenURI
the _tokenURI local holds the per-token URI read from _tokenURIs and is used only inside tokenURI
